text:
Dubai registered 10,195 residential sales totaling AED 27,672,330,524 in the last four weeks, a 6.1 percent decrease from the previous period. Mortgage registrations reached 4,054, which are recorded separately from sales transactions. The off-plan share of sales stood at 59.4 percent, down from 66.6 percent in the prior four weeks.

The median residential price per square foot was AED 1,666, representing a 1.8 percent decline compared to the previous four weeks. Top sales volumes over twelve weeks were led by Dubai South with 3,783 units at a median of AED 1,693 per square foot. Jumeirah Village Circle followed with 2,313 sales at AED 1,407 per square foot, while Down Town Jabal Ali recorded 2,231 sales at AED 1,744 per square foot.

Rental activity included 92,517 Ejari contracts with a 50.2 percent renewal share. The median residential rent was AED 70,000. Estimated gross yields were highest in Zaabeel First at 9.1 percent for flats, followed by International City Ph 1 at 8.6 percent and Town Square at 7.0 percent.

Twelve-week price changes show Al Yufrah 1 heating at 37.7 percent and Saih Shuaib 1 at 13.4 percent. Cooling areas include Liwan at minus 14.0 percent and Palm Deira at minus 13.3 percent. The anomaly monitor flagged 1,076 sales in the last 60 days priced more than 35 percent away from comparable medians. Figures are derived from registered DLD data and Ejari contracts using medians and benchmark filters that exclude bulk deals and outliers.

facts.ranking_rule: communities with at least 30 eligible sales in both 12-week windows; yields also need 30 rent contracts of the same property type
